jobs.title: Creative Lead EMEA and APAC
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The team is comprised of 5 senior creative leads (directors) of high caliber and experience. Half are focused on EMEA the others on APAC. There is a high level of autonomy and the quality of work is consistently excellent. Each lead manages all aspects of creative development, production, post-production and delivery with or without agencies. Excellent judgment, taste and communication skills are required. A strong background or direct experience with how business is done in diverse cultures is helpful. The team works well together. There is collective support from one member of the team for the other, there are no rivalries. Several members of the team will benefit from mentoring. This high performing team will have strong expectations of their leader and will be watching vigilantly.

Responsibilities
- Create a sustainable, motivated and efficient environment for exceptional creative development. Demonstrate creative thought leadership, keeping ahead of trends and providing proactive inspiration and recommendations.
- Lead and collaborate with extraordinary creatives, copywriters, designers, innovators and strategists.
- Provide the in-house creatives with a clear creative direction and ownership over their projects. Continually raise the bar for creative excellence.
- Work closely with world class advertising agencies across EMEA nd APAC in guiding the work effectively for creative excellence. Be a fiscal guardian working in the best interests of the company.
- Demonstrate brand guardianship and proactively identify areas to improve on the creative
- Work collaboratively to develop compelling creative solutions with the team, that align with the strategic brief
- Partner closely with both global and local marketing teams to develop breakthrough creative work that balances commercial needs with innovation and longer-term brand building.
- Manage creativity within the parameters of project allocation and resources.

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications
- Extensive work experience as a CD, ECD, Creative lead or related position
- Team leadership experience
- Previous experience of leading and delivering a broad range of creative projects including brand campaigns, activations, creative partnership solutions etc

Preferred qualifications
- Strong knowledge of the EMEA and APAC regions and grasp on culture, with a keen understanding of what is relevant, and an eye for upcoming trends
- Demonstrate keen knowledge of TikTok and the TikTok community.
- Demonstrate proactive thinking and examples of your entrepreneurialism (in work or out of work).
- Ability to manage team bandwidth and delivery timelines.
- Must be dependable, positive, and open-minded, and be able to clearly communicate both verbally and visually.
- Ability to pitch creative solutions in response to marketing strategies. 
- Excellent presentation and communication skills. Ability to read a room and pivot accordingly.
- Portfolio of work

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

jobs.title: Creative Producer - 18 month contract
jobs.description:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

We're seeking a Creative Producer on an 18-month fixed-term contract to develop and produce an innovative fiction audio experience for an upcoming Audible Original title. This is a dedicated, time-bound production role: you will take this project from early development through to final delivery within the contract period, after which the completed work will be handed over to the permanent Content team.

Reporting to the Content Innovation Lead, you will be a hands-on creative who brings this project to life through emerging production methodologies and technologies.

This position exists to deliver a specific Audible Original title that requires specialist creative production expertise during its development and production phase and is not an ongoing support role. The 18-month contract reflects the defined lifecycle of this project — from concept development through final delivery.

About You

You're  as comfortable in a writers' room as you are experimenting with new tools, and you see technology not as a constraint but as a creative canvas. You’re equally at home managing production schedules, tracking budgets, and keeping complex workflows on course — bringing the same rigour to a delivery timeline as you do to a storyline. You have a bias toward action, a love of narrative craft, and the instinct to make things that haven't been made before.

As a Creative Producer, you will...

Develop and produce the upcoming Audible Original title from concept through to a fully delivered audio experience within the contract period
Collaborate with writers, production talent, and technologists to build immersive narrative experiences — for this specific production
Manage talent and production partner engagements for this production, including offers and contracting
Work with internal technical partners to bring creative concepts to life through new technological capabilities
Manage creator relationships with sensitivity and craft, building trust with talent across a range of comfort levels with new technology
Prototype and experiment rapidly alongside the Content Innovation team, testing creative concepts before committing to full production
Manage production quality, budget, and schedule across the title's concurrent workstreams, ensuring milestones are met within the 18-month timeline
Incorporate listener research and feedback to iterate and refine experiences — ahead of final delivery
Collaborate with other internal stakeholders across production, marketing, and PR to ensure launch readiness
At the conclusion of this contract, deliver all final production assets, documentation, vendor relationships, and workflows to the permanent Content team via a structured handover

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience
Experience in content production within audio, podcasting, television, film, gaming, or interactive digital media
Demonstrated experience producing scripted narrative content (narrative games, audio drama, fiction podcasts, episodic storytelling, or equivalent)
Background in interactive media, game narrative, or non-linear storytelling
Experience managing creative talent and external production partners
Strong understanding of story structure, character development, and serialized formats
Experience with production budgeting, scheduling, and vendor/freelancer management

Preferred Qualifications

Excellent communication and collaboration skills across creative and technical teams
Experience with non-linear narrative design or interactive storytelling platforms
Familiarity with AI tools and their emerging applications in creative production
Experience working in or with writers' rooms or multi-writer collaborative structures
Experience producing content for global markets or across multiple territories
